title: Scheana Shay Reacts to Jax Taylor’s Cancer Diagnosis, Reveals He Blocked Her Again
summary: Scheana Shay reacted to the news of former 'Vanderpump Rules' castmate Jax Taylor's cancer diagnosis on Reality Checked on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
Scheana Shay didn’t get the chance to wish her former[Vanderpump Rules](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/vanderpump-rules) castmate Jax Taylor well personally, following the announcement about his cancer diagnosis. In fact, while guest hosting[Radio Andy’s Reality Checked](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/reality-checked) on November 19, Scheana revealed that she’s blocked from seeing all of his content. Listen to the full episode exclusively on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogScheanaShayJaxTaylorRealityChecked) .


[Has Anyone Checked On Scheana? Reality Checked Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogScheanaShayJaxTaylorRealityChecked)


“I’m again blocked by Jax so I don’t see anything,” Scheana told KiKi Monique. “Probably because of the things I said on my podcast after the Lori of it all.”


After it was revealed that Jax had been in a relationship with his and ex-wife Brittany Cartwright’s former publicist, Lori Krebs, Scheana found it hard to believe he was a new man.


- **Related:[Scheana Shay Says Jax Is Bad But ‘You Don’t Know How Bad Jesse Lally Is’](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/scheana-shay-jesse-the-valley)**


“I thought he actually was changing,” she explained. “The messages I had received from him about six months ago, he had shown growth and change, and I was like, ‘Wow.'”


“I was at Jasmine \[Goode\] and Melissa \[Carelli\] wedding, which was right around his birthday, and I was telling Brittany, ‘Oh yeah, Jax reached out and this and that.’ And she tells me the messages she’s receiving,” she added. “That’s when I was like, ‘I’m done with this. You’ve changed and then the Lori of it all came out, and I was like, ‘Sayonara.'”


As for his diagnosis, Scheana admitted that she can see why fans have so many questions about the state of his health, outside of what he shared with the world.


“Yeah, when you’ve cried wolf so many times, it does lead people to ask questions,” she said. “So is he doing chemo? Radiation? Did they get it in surgery?”


- **Related:[Stassi Schroeder Reveals How She Got Katie Maloney Back on Reality TV](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/stassi-schroeder-katie-maloney-reality-tv-smith-sisters-live)**


In all, Scheana does wish Jax–who has remained active on Cameo–the best for the sake of his and Brittany’s 5-year-old son, Cruz.


“I mean take that money and how about you start putting that towards Cruz’s medical expenses,” she suggested. “I hope for Cruz’s sake that his dad remains healthy, but I also hope his dad contributes.”


Plus, during the show, Scheana also responded to Ariana Biermann’s claims that she was rude.
